name: McKenzie River
blurb: Clear, cold, and quick — the river the McKenzie drift boat was built for, east of Eugene.

sections.notes: Fast, continuous and cold even in August. Take out at Ben and Kay Dorris to avoid Marten Rapid immediately downstream.

putInAccess.sourceName: Oregon State Marine Board Boat Oregon access inventory
putInAccess.note: Agency launch record and satellite imagery agree on this riverside access facility. The marker is an approximate facility location, not a surveyed landing edge.
putInAccess.directions: Use the signed public entrance and designated river access at Finn Rock Landing. Check the operator’s current hours and seasonal conditions before arranging the shuttle.
